capabilities: Render recipe notes as interactive cards
Plan weekly meals by dragging recipes onto a planner

Import recipes from URLs and other apps
extras: Nextcloud Pantry sync is off by default and must be enabled in settings; beta releases are distributed through BRAT.
problem: Recipes, meal plans and shopping lists usually live in separate apps, apart from the notes a user keeps in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Recipe Box syncs your grocery list both ways with a checklist in the Nextcloud Pantry app.
